board: FEETECH FS90R micro continuous rotation servo (Adafruit #2442 / Pololu #2820), 3-wire JR lead
reason: Modelled from the FEETECH FS90R spec: 700-2300 us, stop at 1500 us, 90 us dead band, CW below 1500 us, 4.8-6 V supply on V+ with up to 800 mA at stall. The check passed on ESP32 and Pico, with the cw/ccw/stop simulator test, a clean DRC and the footprint.
breakoutPinoutSource: Standard JR servo lead order GND/V+/SIG (brown/red/orange; orange control wire per https://www.adafruit.com/product/2442, JR connector per https://www.pololu.com/product/2820)
